data.action: 站在数据架前检索终端
data.description: 【佩丽卡 · 数据档案室】高耸如森林的数据核心存储室内，佩丽卡站在高亮的光电检索终端前，熟练地调用并备份着开拓初期遗留的旧文明数据。她侧过头看向你——「过往的拓荒先驱用生命铺就了前路。把这些数据完整传承下去，正是我们身为管理层的责任。」
data.promptProse: At a bright retrieval terminal in the data archive, Perlica backs up old civilization records and turns her head toward the Administrator. Her white techwear jacket and high-neck tunic remain visible beside the working glove in medium close-up. Tall storage cores form parallel rows behind her. Soft terminal glow catches her cheek and sleeve cuff, fading gradually across the darker column faces farther from the screen.
data.title: 佩丽卡 · 数据档案室
